item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Performance interlude 2 2026-08-16 This update doesn’t contain changes to vxray. While the spatially cached RTAO both looks better and improves performance, the performance on the Macbook Air (M2) is still not amazing when moving around the interiors of the Sponza scene compared to before. A look at the Metal profiler timeline reveals that the RTAO hashmap update pass takes the most time during the frame. It also reveals that the gbuffer pass, which casts rays against the voxels, has a bloated register allocation of 89, up from 77.
